covers.title: 心冷了
covers.prompt: A frozen heart-shaped ice cube rests on a rain-streaked windowsill. An empty dining table holds two pairs of chopsticks across from a vacant chair. The Chinese characters '心冷了' are etched into the ice cube's surface. Cool blue tones. Vertical 2:3.

covers.title: 爱爱爱
covers.prompt: In the warm morning sun, a young person squats at the door eating breakfast while a phone glows with a good-morning message. In the distance, square-dance enthusiasts move to a heart-shaped neon sign whose glow naturally forms the Chinese characters '爱爱爱'. The scene is bathed in warm orange, captured in a vertical 2:3 format.

covers.title: 小毛驴
covers.prompt: A worn plush donkey toy sits on the dusty village path, facing the old locust tree and curling kitchen smoke. The Chinese characters '小毛驴' naturally appear in the smoke swirls above the rooftops. Warm orange tones, vertical 2:3 format.

covers.title: 雨中曲
covers.prompt: A lone rain-soaked oil-paper umbrella stands in a courtyard, the Chinese characters '雨中曲' etched into its paper surface. Raindrops drum on broad banana leaves and drip from tiled eaves onto a glistening stone path. A figure in a blue robe waits beneath the umbrella. Cold blue tones, vertical 2:3.

covers.title: 蹦呲呲
covers.prompt: A lone dancer stands in the center of a flashing dance floor, tears falling into a glass of liquor. A massive bass speaker booms with energy, and the Chinese characters '蹦呲呲' are etched into its grille. Warm orange and cool blue lighting, vertical 2:3.
